reason: A DeepSeek Harness web profile plugin that adds a draggable animated desktop pet reflecting agent activity, with interaction audio and debugging endpoints.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中添加可拖动的桌宠，根据智能体状态展示动画、提示气泡并提供互动音效。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable animated desktop pet to the DeepSeek Harness web interface that reflects agent states with status bubbles and interaction sounds.

capabilities: Displays a draggable animated desktop pet overlay in the DeepSeek Harness web interface
Observes agent, tool execution, approval, and error status events to update the pet state
Plays local completion and interaction audio
Provides a kun_pet_debug tool and local state and asset HTTP routes
